title: Sharing the Happy News
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When something wonderful takes place,
We want to run and tell,
A song says, 'Come and hear the things
That God has done so well!'

[Chorus]
Come and hear, come and hear the news,
Of good things God has done,
When you share His goodness, your joy
Grows bigger than the sun.

[Verse 2]
He was so thankful and so glad,
He told each one he found,
'Let me tell you what God has done!'
He shared it all around.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; tomorrow you
Can share the happy news,
Tonight rest close to God's warm love,
He's near you while you snooze.

[Chorus]
mood: Skipping music. A bright, quick-footed pulse like a child running to tell everyone something wonderful, matching a story about sharing good news. The sway is open and eager through the verses, with a lift on each 'come and hear.' By the last verse the skip slows to a walk and then a rock, lower and quieter, as the news is tucked away for tomorrow.
